claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting plateau pressure <30 cmH2O and tidal volume ~6 mL/kg predicted body weight, while monitoring peak and plateau pressures.
Titrate inspired oxygen to maintain SpO2 92-96% and reassess arterial blood gas within 24 hours given hypercapnia and respiratory acidosis.
Manage hyperglycemia with the insulin infusion and frequent point-of-care glucose checks, targeting glucose 140-180 mg/dL.
Continue sedation with midazolam and fentanyl infusions, titrating to the target RASS, and reassess sedation and delirium at least every shift.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis with pantoprazole and reassess indication daily.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin and monitor for bleeding.
Replete electrolytes as needed, with particular attention to potassium and magnesium, and recheck a basic metabolic panel within 24 hours.
Review sputum culture results and reassess antibiotic coverage, considering de-escalation of vancomycin, cefepime, and azithromycin based on cultures and clinical course.
Perform daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial assessment to evaluate readiness for extubation.
Provide oral care and subglottic suctioning, and maintain head-of-bed elevation to reduce ventilator-associated pneumonia risk.
